reason: The only offered action should prepare a secure place for the lift module.
expectation: I expect the padded mount to attach to the frame, ready for the module; I’m not sure what comes next.

effect: The mount is in place, so the lift module can now be fitted.
reaction: A straightforward preparation; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The lift module is the only offered combination and needs a secure place in the whale.
expectation: I expect the module to fit into the padded mount, with its controls still accessible.

effect: The lift module is fitted, leaving the skin as the next offered step.
reaction: The assembly is straightforward so far.
reason: The only offered combination should give the whale its outer covering.
expectation: I expect the translucent skin to cover the frame while leaving a way to reach the workings, though the hatch may come later.

effect: The whale now has its paper skin; the hatch is the next offered fitting.
reaction: The covering went on as expected, without further detail.
reason: The only offered combination should provide access to the workings.
expectation: I expect the hinged hatch to fit into the skin and open for servicing.

effect: The hatch provides access to the controller and counterweight while preserving the whale’s shape.
reaction: That makes the purpose of leaving access clear.
reason: The only offered combination should make the stop accessible from outside.
expectation: I expect the extension to connect to the existing stop switch so it can be operated without opening the hatch.

effect: The exterior button now reaches the stop switch, and the low battery and counterweight position explains how the lift module is arranged. The chapter goal is complete.
reaction: The pushrod and low-hanging weight made the final fitting more informative than the earlier assembly steps.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the outside stop button was most worthwhile: the result explained both its pushrod and how the module’s weight hangs below the lift.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the skin felt least substantial because the result only named the covered whale without explaining anything further.

surprise.text: I had expected the button to reach the switch, but the pushrod and the explanation of the low-mounted weight added useful detail.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless, though the padded mount was a straightforward required preparation rather than an interesting decision.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see the assembled whale used, although this chapter’s mostly single-option fittings were not especially engaging on their own.
